newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU reviews Ahold /CSC buy of Store 2000.
newsitem.headline: EU reviews Ahold /CSC buy of Store 2000.

text.p: The European Commission said on Friday it was reviewing a deal by which Dutch retail food group Koninklijke Ahold NV and Central de Serveis Ciencies (CSC) acquire joint control of Spanish food retail firm Store 2000.
It said the operation was submitted for clearance on October 30 under the European Union's merger rules. The Commission has about a month from that date to clear the deal or start a full probe.

The deal also involved Ahold's subsidiary in Spain, the Commission said in a statement published in the EU's Official Journal. CSC is also a food retail firm in Catalunia and the Balearic Islands. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
